collections.title: Complete Fingerboards
collections.body_html: Assembled and ready to skate out of the box — real maple decks, metal trucks and genuine bearing wheels. The board you buy when the plastic one stopped being enough.

collections.title: Decks
collections.body_html: Bare decks for riders building their own setup. Choose your width, concave and graphic, then bolt on the trucks and wheels you already trust.

collections.title: Trucks
collections.body_html: The first upgrade that changes how a board actually rides. Single axle, inverted and regular kingpin geometry across every common deck width.

collections.title: Wheels
collections.body_html: Urethane and CNC wheels with real, rated bearings — the part that fails first on a cheap board, and the easiest way to make a setup feel new.

collections.title: Grip Tape
collections.body_html: Foam grip tape in uncut sheets, plus the file to trim it cleanly. Cut it to your own deck shape for a finish that looks deliberate.

collections.title: Tuning & Hardware
collections.body_html: Bushings, pivot cups, bearings, locknuts, baseplates and tools. The tuning layer that keeps a setup turning sweetly and holds it together.

collections.title: Ramps & Obstacles
collections.body_html: Single pieces in wood and metal — quarter pipes, rails, ledges, stairs and walls. Equipment that earns its place on a desk between sessions.

collections.title: Park Kits & Sets
collections.body_html: Multi-piece sets and complete parks. Modular pieces you can rearrange into new lines, and expand one obstacle at a time.

collections.title: Deck Building & Molds
collections.body_html: Press your own decks. Concave molds across shallow, medium and deep profiles, plus dyed maple veneer — the part of fingerboarding almost nobody stocks.

collections.title: Storage & Display
collections.body_html: Cases and bags that protect a collection in transit and make it look considered at rest.
